_comment: Edit ONLY the values below, then delete this comment. These are the local, Google-Drive-for-Desktop-synced folder paths on YOUR machine -- not paths inside this project. Claude Code reads this file at the start of every business review cycle to find your real input/output locations. Use forward slashes even on Windows (e.g. C:/Users/you/Google Drive/My Drive/...).
_input_model: Each cycle, inputs_subfolder should hold exactly ONE file: a multi-tab Excel workbook is the expected/best-supported case (one tab per category -- see .claude/skills/business-review-automation/references/standard-input-file-templates.md), but a single .docx, .pdf, or .pptx is also accepted and extracted best-effort into the same categories.
_fallback_if_drive_not_configured: data/inputs and data/outputs inside this project folder
